name: Vibrant
description: The default. Warm sun, rich colours, glowing borders, light shafts.

name: Realistic
description: The game's own colours and sky; only the light is new.

name: Golden Hour
description: Clear sky, low warm sun, long light shafts.

name: Dreamy
description: Soft pastel bloom, pink and teal.

name: Neon
description: Starry night, bright neon that lights up the whole track.

name: Horizon
description: A glowing black hole and a ringed planet over a dark stadium.

name: Aurora
description: Northern lights over the track, green and teal.

name: Competition
description: Clarity first: shadows and depth, no haze or lens effects.

name: Performance
description: The Vibrant look for weaker GPUs: fewer samples, no shafts.

name: Rainy
description: Overcast, wet track, puddles and rain.

name: Replay Cinema
description: Film look with motion blur and depth of field, for replays.

name: Storm
description: Low clouds, pouring rain, deep puddles, lightning and thunder.

name: Snowstorm
description: A blizzard: driving snow and thick haze close around you.

name: Horror
description: Black night in thick fog. Only your headlights light the road.
